summary.headline: Astrological Topics 306–327
summary.text: Astrological chapter list from a Florentine codex, covering parallax, interposition, void of course, affliction, application and conjunction, house lord and predominator, sign relationships, zodiac quadrants, fertile signs, ascensional times, inception charts, weather signs, and death; chapter 313 cites Dorotheus.
